svg.aria-label: Issue #05: Milk Bank Optimizer (2025). A calculator website for milk bank staff that works out how to split donated milk into suitable batches, combining donations into pools that meet calorie and protein targets instead of balancing them by hand. Built in React and hosted on Firebase with Dream Team Engineering.
